videos.title: Why so many VPs of product are quietly missing life as an IC
videos.description:
Becoming a VP, sitting in meetings all day sounds like the dream. Until you actually get there.

Tom Verrilli (CPO of Whatnot) on why so many VPs of product are quietly missing life as an IC.

videos.title: Product managers exist because of scale. They are by no means a neccessity.
videos.description:
Product managers exist because of scale. They are by no means a necessity.

After leading product at Twitch and Twitter, Tom Verrilli (CPO of Whatnot) is rethinking why the role exists at all.

videos.title: This CPO regrets that product management exists | Tom Verrilli (CPO of Whatnot)
